Name: Unleash Life
Desc: Unleash elemental forces of Life, healing a friendly target for 2,592. Increases the healing of your next Riptide, Chain Heal, or Healing Wave by 25% and reduces its cast time by 30%.

Name: Call of the Ancestors
Desc: Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec. Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.

Name: Earthen Accord
Desc: Unleash Life heals for 30% more and its bonus healing effect is increased by 20%.

Name: Voltaic Blaze
Desc: Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing 1,698 Nature damage. Always critically strikes. Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

Name: Crackling Fury
Desc: Voltaic Blaze's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec and its instant damage is increased by 50%.

Name: Fire Nova
Desc: Voltaic Blaze generates 2 additional Maelstrom Weapon and has a 30% chance to cause a Fire Nova. Fire Nova Erupt a burst of fiery damage from all targets affected by your Flame Shock, dealing 2,544 Volcanic damage to up to 6 targets within

Name: Purging Flames
Desc: Voltaic Blaze unleashes volcanic rage, causing your next Lava Burst to also fire at 5 additional targets with your Flame Shock at 80% effectiveness with reduced Maelstrom generation. Lava Burst damage increased by 10%.

Name: Water Shield
Desc: The caster is surrounded by globes of water, granting mana per 5 sec. When a melee attack hits the caster, the caster regains {(/100+1)*}% of their mana. This effect can only occur once every {+(/1000)}.1 sec.

Name: Wind Rush Totem
Desc: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.

Name: Ascending Air
Desc: Wind Rush Totem's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec and its movement speed effect lasts an additional 2 sec.

Name: Jet Stream
Desc: Wind Rush Totem's movement speed bonus is increased by 10% and now removes snares.

Name: Wind Shear
Desc: Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

Name: Windveil
Desc: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

Name: Windfury Weapon
Desc: Imbue your main-hand weapon with the element of Wind for 1 hrs. Each main-hand attack has a 15% chance to trigger two extra attacks, dealing 713 Physical damage each.

Name: Unruly Winds
Desc: Windfury Weapon has a 100% chance to trigger a third attack.

Name: Amped Up
Desc: Increases your haste by 3%.

Name: Ancestral Influence
Desc: Your Intellect is increased by 1.0% for each Ancestor active.

Name: Ancient Fellowship
Desc: Ancestors have a 20% chance to call another Ancestor for 8 sec when they depart.

Name: Brimming with Life
Desc: Stamina increased by 8%. While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.

Name: Charged Conduit
Desc: Increases the duration of Lightning Rod by 4 sec and its damage bonus by 25%.

Name: Earthen Rage
Desc: Your damaging spells incite the earth around you to come to your aid for 6 sec, repeatedly dealing 180 Nature damage to your most recently attacked target.

Name: Earthsurge
Desc: Allies affected by your Earthliving effect receive 15% increased healing from you.

Name: Echo Chamber
Desc: Increases the damage dealt by your Elemental Overloads by 25%.

Name: Electroshock
Desc: Tempest increases your movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.

Name: Elemental Attunement
Desc: Mastery increased by 2%.

Name: Elemental Fury
Desc: Your damaging critical strikes deal 250% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Name: Elemental Resonance
Desc: All Elemental damage increased by 3%.

Name: Elemental Unity
Desc: While a Fire Elemental is active, your Fire damage dealt is increased by 6%. While a Storm Elemental is active, your Nature damage dealt is increased by 6%.

Name: Elemental Warding
Desc: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.

Name: Elemental Weapons
Desc: Each active weapon imbue increases all Fire, Frost, and Nature damage dealt by 5.0%.

Name: Enhanced Imbues
Desc: The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.

Name: Everlasting Elements
Desc: Increases the duration of your Elementals by 20%.

Name: Feedback Loop
Desc: Elemental Overload damage increased by 35%.

Name: Feedback Loop
Desc: Spell critical strike chance increased by 5%. Elemental Fury increases spell critical strike damage by an additional 25%.

Name: Feedback Loop
Desc: Elemental Overloads have a 25% chance to cause an additional Elemental Overload. This effect cannot chain.

Name: Final Calling
Desc: When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally. Hydrobubble Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec. The shield absorbs the next 2,008 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over

Name: Fire and Ice
Desc: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.

Name: Flurry
Desc: Increases your attack speed by 15% for your next 3 melee swings after dealing a critical strike with a spell or ability.

Name: Forceful Winds
Desc: Windfury has a 10% additional chance to trigger and its damage is increased by 50%.

Name: Heed My Call
Desc: Ancestors last an additional 4 sec.

Name: Imbuement Mastery
Desc: Increases the duration of your Earthliving effect by 3 sec.

Name: Latent Wisdom
Desc: Your Ancestors' spells are 25% more powerful.

Name: Natural Gift
Desc: Nature damage is increased by 2%

Name: Natural Harmony
Desc: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.

Name: Nature's Fury
Desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.

Name: Nature's Guardian
Desc: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.

Name: Overcharge
Desc: The critical strike damage of your Nature abilities are increased by 40% of your critical strike chance.

Name: Oversized Totems
Desc: Increases the size and radius of your totems by 15%, and the health of your totems by 30%.

Name: Path of the Seer
Desc: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

Name: Primal Elementalist
Desc: Your Earth, Fire, and Storm Elementals are drawn from primal elementals 80% more powerful than regular elementals, with additional abilities, and you gain direct control over your Primal Fire Elemental.

Name: Primordial Capacity
Desc: Increases your maximum mana by 10%. Tidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.

Name: Primordial Fury
Desc: Elemental Fury increases critical strike damage by an additional 25%.

Name: Spiritual Awakening
Desc: Mastery increased by 3%.

Name: Storm Swell
Desc: Tempest grants 6% Mastery for 6 sec.

Name: Stormbind
Desc: Critical strikes of your Nature abilities reduce the target's movement speed by 60% for 5 sec.

Name: Stormcaller
Desc: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature damage spells by 5% and the critical strike damage of your Nature spells by 5%.

Name: Stormstream Totem
Desc: Healing Stream and Stormstream Totem healing increased by 30%.

Name: Totemic Coordination
Desc: Chain Heals from Lively Totem and Totemic Rebound are 25% more effective.

Name: Totemic Focus
Desc: Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%. Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec. Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.

Name: Totemic Surge
Desc: Reduces the cooldown of most totems by 5 sec.

Name: Water Expulsion
Desc: Increases Downpour healing by 20%.

Name: White Water
Desc: Your critical heals have 215% effectiveness instead of the usual 200%.

Name: Wind Barrier
Desc: If you have a totem active, your totem grants you a shield absorbing 25,614 damage for 30 sec every 30 sec.
